cases.prompt: Add a contract approval submission API method and pytest test case in API automation. The capture service is started on 12138, follow capture-driven workflow, append method and case to the end of user-specified files.
must: Pass new task preflight gate first
Check URL deduplication and file encoding before writing
Explain blocking reason if capture service is unavailable
must_not: Modify non-target modules without authorization
Falsify capture failure as API success

cases.prompt: Refer to the structure of existing workflow cases to add a workflow draft creation API test at the end of specified page_api and test_case files. API URL and request fields are per this task.
expected_outputs: Explanation of differences between reference and new cases
List of API methods and test cases
must: Read reference case and corresponding mode doc first
Preserve existing fixtures, markers, and assertion styles
must_not: Rewrite entire files
Fabricate unprovided response fields

cases.prompt: Capture is unavailable. Based on user-provided cURL, response examples, target method file, and case file, add an organization structure query API method and pytest test case in API automation.
expected_outputs: Mapping of request method, URL, payload, and response
List of new API methods and test cases
pytest results or clear environment blocking reason
must: Parse cURL method, headers, payload first
Assert stable fields only against response example
must_not: Halt entire task because capture is unavailable
Write dynamic values from example as hardcoded assertions

cases.prompt: Based on Java Controller source code or Jacoco page, find uncovered APIs against page_api index, and add API methods and pytest test cases.
expected_outputs: Differences between Controller APIs and existing URL index
must: Deduplicate with index before writing code
Explain insufficient evidence if source code or Jacoco is inaccessible
must_not: Treat unconfirmed Controller methods as covered
Batch generate APIs without verification

cases.prompt: Maintain existing leave submission test case. The workflow has changed, capture service is available, please synchronize API methods, payload, assertions, and test cases.
must: Locate existing implementation and calling chain first
Make minimal changes related to workflow changes only
must_not: Append duplicate cases per new creation workflow
Overwrite historical behavior not specified by user

cases.prompt: Maintain budget list test case so its assertion and parametrization styles match budget details case; localized edits required while preserving existing business semantics.
expected_outputs: Differences between reference case and target case
must: Distinguish portable style from non-portable business assertions
Verify compatibility between parametrized data and fixtures
must_not: Copy business assertions from details API
Unrelated refactoring

cases.prompt: Payload for existing meeting booking API changed. User provides new cURL and response; perform targeted maintenance on API method and assertions against old implementation.
expected_outputs: Differences between old payload and new cURL
must: Preserve unchanged fields and session handling
Update assertion hierarchy against real response
must_not: Rewrite maintenance task as new creation task
Modify test assertions while ignoring API methods

cases.prompt: Run specified API automation test case, locate and fix based on real pytest errors, iteratively verify until passing or confirming environment/auth blockage.
expected_outputs: Final pass statistics or environment blockage explanation
must: Diagnose in order: imports, encoding, fixtures, auth, response structure
Rerun target case after each modification
must_not: Claim passing without running pytest
Treat environment/network errors as completed code fixes

cases.prompt: Query whether specified URL already has duplicate implementation in page_api; output matching location and recommendation only without adding code.
expected_outputs: Clear explanation when no match is found
must: Prefer project index/matching tools
Remain read-only
must_not: Modify business files for verification
Misreport path similarity as URL duplicate

cases.prompt: Fix text mojibake in API automation cases to UTF-8 without BOM, verify import paths, and keep business logic unchanged.
must: Confirm file indeed has mojibake or encoding issue first
Re-read and compile after modification
must_not: Fabricate original text by replacing question marks
Modify business assertions along the way

cases.prompt: Run full pytest suite for API automation, count failure inventory only, without modifying test cases.
must: Remain read-only and distinguish environment failures from code failures
Report actual statistics
must_not: Auto-fix business code
Fabricate statistics without executing

cases.prompt: Based on checked [x] API-TPL templates in api-landing.md from git-diff-analyse, add page_api methods and pytest test cases per Mode 5 (API-TPL driven). Strictly follow the 7-step execution process in mode_api_tpl.md.
expected_outputs: List of new API methods (including Trigger Steps:)
List of new test cases (including -- semantic notes)
Confirmation that debug prints are removed
must: Read api-landing.md first to confirm [x] scope
Use page_api_index.sqlite3 for {param} fuzzy L1 deduplication
New method docstrings must include Trigger Steps: prefix
Case docstrings must include -- semantic note
Delete debug prints after all pytest tests pass
Refresh page_api_index before delivery
must_not: Read entire ai-result.md
Read functional-cases.html to write automation
Fabricate trigger steps unrelated to functional test cases
Case title missing -- semantic note
git commit / git push
Process unchecked [ ] API-TPL entries
Exact URL match ignoring {param} placeholder

cases.prompt: Add explicit wait to Selenium UI login flow. This task does not involve API automation.
must: Handle in UI automation context or request corresponding skill
must_not: Read API automation gates and modify page_api
